# Relationship Types

Use the most specific type. Record one direction only: the inverse is implied.

| Category | Types | Genre |
|---|---|---|
| Social | knows, mentors | fantasy |
| Spatial | located_at, part_of | fantasy |

## Inverses

- `mentors` / `mentored_by`
- `part_of` / `contains`

## Symmetric (stored once, no direction)

knows
